question_examples_zh: 為什麼有的東西會浮有的會沉
為什麼游泳圈可以讓我浮起來
facts_en: Water pushes things up. This push is called buoyancy.
A thing that is lighter than the same amount of water floats.
A thing that is heavier than the same amount of water sinks.
Things with air inside, like swim rings and boats, float more easily.
facts_zh: 水會把東西往上推，這個力叫浮力。
東西如果比同樣多的水輕，就會浮起來。
東西如果比同樣多的水重，就會沉下去。
裡面有空氣的東西，像游泳圈和船，比較容易浮。
answers_en: Water pushes up on the {object}. If it is light for its size, it floats.
A thing that is light for its size floats. A heavy one sinks.
Water pushes up on things. Things with air inside float more easily.
answers_zh: 水會把{object}往上推。跟大小比起來輕，就會浮。
東西跟大小比起來很輕，就會浮在水上。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼球丟上去會掉下來
facts_en: The Earth pulls things down. This pull is called gravity.
That is why things fall to the ground when you let go.
Gravity keeps us and everything else on the ground.
The Moon pulls less than the Earth, so things feel lighter there.
facts_zh: 地球會把東西往下拉，這個力叫重力。
所以東西放手就會掉到地上。
重力把我們和所有東西留在地面上。
月亮的拉力比地球小，所以東西在那裡會變輕。
answers_en: The Earth pulls the {object} down.
The {object} comes down because the Earth pulls on it.
The Earth pulls everything toward the ground.
answers_zh: 地球會把{object}往下拉。這個力叫重力。
地球把所有東西往地面拉。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼球滾一滾會停下來
facts_en: When two things rub together, a push-back slows the movement. It is called friction.
Rough surfaces have more friction. Slippery surfaces have less.
Rubbing makes things warm, and it slowly stops sliding things.
facts_zh: 兩個東西互相磨的時候，會有一種擋住動作的力，叫摩擦力。
粗粗的地方摩擦力大，滑滑的地方摩擦力小。
摩擦會讓東西變熱，也會讓滑動的東西慢慢停下來。
answers_en: When things rub together, friction slows them down.
Rough things rub more. Slippery things rub less.
Things rub on the {object}, so they slow down.
answers_zh: 東西互相磨，會有摩擦力。
粗的地方擋得多，滑的地方擋得少。

facts_en: A magnet pulls on things that have iron in them, like nails and paper clips.
A magnet has two ends. Two of the same ends push apart, and two different ends pull together.
A magnet can pull on a thing without touching it.
Not everything sticks to a magnet. Paper and plastic do not.
facts_zh: 磁鐵會吸住有鐵的東西，像鐵釘和迴紋針。
磁鐵有兩端，一樣的兩端會推開，不一樣的兩端會吸在一起。
磁鐵不用碰到東西，也能拉住它。
不是所有東西都被磁鐵吸，像紙和塑膠就不會。
answers_en: Magnets pull on things that have iron in them.
A magnet sticks to the {object} only if it has iron.
Magnets can pull from a little way off. They pull on iron.
answers_zh: 磁鐵會吸住有鐵的東西。
磁鐵吸不吸{object}，要看有沒有鐵。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼有的聲音高有的聲音低
我們為什麼聽得到聲音
facts_en: When something shakes back and forth (vibrates), it makes a sound.
Sound travels through the air to our ears.
Fast shaking makes a high sound. Slow shaking makes a low sound.
Big shaking makes a loud sound.
facts_zh: 東西一抖一抖（振動）就會發出聲音。
聲音會透過空氣傳到我們的耳朵。
抖得快，聲音就高；抖得慢，聲音就低。
抖得大力，聲音就大聲。
answers_en: The {object} shakes very fast, and that makes the sound.
Sounds come from shaking. The {object} shakes, and the air carries the sound to you.
Fast shaking makes high sounds. Slow shaking makes low sounds.
answers_zh: {object}抖得很快，就會有聲音。
東西一抖，聲音就跑到你的耳朵。

question_examples_en: why do I hear my voice come back in a tunnel

question_examples_zh: 為什麼在隧道大叫會聽到自己的聲音
facts_en: Sound bounces off hard, flat things, like walls and cliffs.
The bounced sound comes back to our ears a moment later. That is an echo.
Soft things, like curtains and carpets, soak up sound, so there is less echo.
facts_zh: 聲音碰到又硬又平的東西，像牆和山壁，會彈回來。
彈回來的聲音慢一點點才到耳朵，就是回音。
窗簾和地毯軟軟的，會吸住聲音，回音就比較少。
answers_en: Sound bounces off hard walls. In the {object}, it comes back to your ears.
That is an echo. Your sound hits a hard wall and bounces back to you.
Hard, flat walls bounce sound back. That is why the {object} has an echo.
answers_zh: 聲音碰到硬牆會彈回來，所以有回音。
在{object}裡，聲音彈回來又到你的耳朵。

facts_en: Light travels in straight lines.
When something blocks the light, a shadow appears behind it.
Light goes through clear things like glass, but not through solid things like wood.
The closer the light is to the object, the bigger the shadow.
facts_zh: 光是直直走的。
東西擋住光，後面就會有影子。
光可以穿過透明的東西，像玻璃，但穿不過不透明的東西，像木頭。
光離東西越近，影子就越大。
answers_en: The {object} blocks the light. So there is a shadow behind it.
Light goes in straight lines. It cannot bend around things.
Light goes through clear things, like glass. It cannot go through wood.
answers_zh: {object}擋住了光，後面就有影子。
光是直直走的。穿得過玻璃，穿不過木頭。

為什麼黑色的衣服夏天比較熱
facts_en: When light hits a shiny thing, it bounces back.
A mirror is very smooth, so it bounces the light back neatly and we see ourselves.
White things bounce back a lot of light. Black things take in more light.
We see things because light bounces off them into our eyes.
facts_zh: 光碰到亮亮光光的東西，會彈回來。
鏡子很光滑，會把光整齊地彈回來，所以我們看到自己。
白色的東西會把很多光彈回來，黑色的東西吸住比較多光。
我們看得到東西，是因為光從東西彈到我們的眼睛。
answers_en: Light bounces off the {object} and back to your eyes.
Shiny, smooth things bounce light back. The {object} is like that.
We see things when light bounces off them into our eyes.
answers_zh: 光會從{object}彈回你的眼睛。
又亮又滑的東西，會把光彈回來。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼肥皂泡泡有很多顏色
為什麼下雨後會有彩虹
facts_en: Sunlight looks white, but it has many colors hidden inside.
When light goes through tiny drops of water, the colors spread apart and make a rainbow.
Rainbows are easiest to see when the sun comes out after rain.
A rainbow shows colors from red at one edge to violet at the other.
facts_zh: 太陽光看起來是白的，裡面其實藏著很多顏色。
光穿過小水珠的時候，顏色會分開，就變成彩虹。
下過雨、太陽出來的時候，最容易看到彩虹。
彩虹一邊是紅色，另一邊是紫色。
answers_en: Sunlight has many colors hidden in it. Water drops spread them apart.
Light hits the {object}, and the colors spread out.
White light is made of many colors. Water or glass can show them.
answers_zh: 太陽光裡藏著很多顏色。水珠會把它們分開。
光照到{object}，顏色就分開了。

為什麼游泳池裡的腳看起來變短了

facts_en: Light bends when it goes from water into air, or from glass into air.
Our eyes think light comes straight, so a thing in water looks bent or in the wrong place.
A magnifying glass and glasses bend light on purpose to help us see.
facts_zh: 光從水裡跑到空氣裡，或從玻璃跑到空氣裡，會拐彎。
我們的眼睛以為光是直直來的，所以水裡的東西看起來彎彎的或位置不對。
放大鏡和眼鏡故意把光拐彎，幫我們看清楚。
answers_en: Light bends in water, so the {object} looks different.
Your eyes think light comes straight. Bent light tricks them.
Water and glass bend light. A magnifying glass bends it to make things look big.
answers_zh: 光在水裡拐彎，{object}就變樣了。
水和玻璃會把光拐彎，眼睛就被騙了。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼太陽下山時天空是紅的
為什麼日落的天空是橘色的
facts_en: Sunlight has many colors in it.
The air bounces blue light around the whole sky, so the sky looks blue.
At sunrise and sunset, the sunlight travels through more air.
Most of the blue is bounced away on the way, so we see red and orange.
facts_zh: 太陽光裡有很多顏色。
空氣會把藍色的光彈到整個天空，所以天空看起來是藍的。
日出和日落的時候，太陽光要穿過比較多的空氣。
大部分的藍光在路上被彈開了，所以我們看到紅色和橘色。
answers_en: Sunlight has many colors. The air bounces the blue around the sky.
At sunset, light goes through lots of air. Blue bounces away, and red stays.
Blue light bounces around the sky more than red light.
answers_zh: 太陽光有很多顏色。空氣把藍色彈到天空各處。
日落時，藍光被彈開，剩下紅色和橘色。

principles.name_en: Heat moves from hot to cold
principles.name_zh: 熱會從熱的地方跑到冷的地方
question_examples_en: why does hot soup get cold
why does ice cream melt when it sits out
why does metal feel cold

question_examples_zh: 為什麼熱湯放著會變涼
為什麼金屬摸起來冰冰的
為什麼冰淇淋放外面會變軟
facts_en: Heat moves from a hot thing to a cooler thing.
Hot soup left out slowly gives its heat to the air, so it cools down.
A cold thing left out takes heat from around it, so it slowly gets warmer.
Metal passes heat quickly, so it feels colder than wood to touch.
facts_zh: 熱會從熱的東西跑到冷的東西。
熱湯放著，熱慢慢跑到空氣裡，就變涼了。
冰的東西放在外面，會吸走旁邊的熱，所以會慢慢變暖。
金屬很會傳熱，所以摸起來比木頭冰。
answers_en: Heat moves from hot things to cooler things. The {object} gives or takes heat from nearby things.
Heat always moves toward the cooler thing.
Warm things give heat away to cooler things around them.
answers_zh: 熱會從熱的東西跑到冷的東西。
{object}和旁邊的東西在交換熱。

why does ice cream melt
why does water turn into ice

why does a candle get soft
why does the pond freeze in winter
question_examples_zh: 為什麼巧克力在手上會變軟
facts_en: When water gets cold enough, it freezes into ice.
When ice gets warm, it melts into water.
Many things, like chocolate and candle wax, also soften and melt when they are warm.
facts_zh: 水變冷到夠冷，就會結成冰。
冰變暖了，就會融化成水。
很多東西，像巧克力和蠟燭，熱了也會變軟、融化。
answers_en: When the {object} gets warm enough, it melts.
Heat makes some things soft and runny. Cold makes them hard again.
Water freezes into ice when it gets cold enough. Warm ice melts.
answers_zh: {object}變暖了，就會融化。
水夠冷就會變成冰，冰變暖又會變回水。

principles.name_en: Drying up (water goes into the air)
principles.name_zh: 東西變乾（水跑到空氣裡）
question_examples_en: why do puddles go away
why do wet clothes get dry
where does the water go when it dries
why does my hair dry
why does the road get dry after rain

why do my hands get dry
question_examples_zh: 為什麼曬太陽衣服乾得比較快
facts_en: Water slowly turns into invisible water in the air. This is called drying up.
Sun and wind make water dry faster.
When the water goes away, things in it, like salt, stay behind.
facts_zh: 水會慢慢變成看不見的水氣，飛到空氣裡。
太陽曬、風吹，水乾得比較快。
水飛走了，水裡的東西像鹽，會留下來。
answers_en: The water in the {object} slowly goes into the air. You cannot see it.
Water turns into invisible water in the air. Sun and wind help it go faster.
The {object} dries because its water floats away into the air.
answers_zh: {object}的水慢慢飛到空氣裡。
太陽曬、風吹，水會跑得更快。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼冰飲料杯子外面有水珠
為什麼冬天呼出來的氣是白的
facts_en: The air has invisible water in it.
When this water touches a cold thing, it turns back into tiny drops.
That is why a cold drink glass gets wet outside and windows fog up on cold days.
facts_zh: 空氣裡有看不見的水氣。
水氣碰到冰冷的東西，會變回小水滴。
所以冰飲料的杯子外面會有水珠，冷天窗戶上也會起霧。
answers_en: Water in the air makes drops on the cold {object}.
Invisible water in the air turns into drops on cold things.
The drops come from the air, not from the {object}.
answers_zh: 空氣裡的水碰到冷的{object}，變成水珠。
水珠是空氣裡的水變的。

principles.name_en: Where rain and water come from
question_examples_en: why does it rain
where does rain come from
how does water get into the sky
where does the river water go
why does rain fall from the clouds
how do clouds make rain
where does the water in the sea come from
does rain go back up
facts_en: The sun warms water in the sea, rivers and ground, and it rises into the air.
High in the sky it cools and turns into tiny drops that gather as clouds.
When the drops in a cloud get big and heavy, they fall as rain.
The rain flows to rivers and the sea, and the water travels again.
facts_zh: 太陽曬熱海、河和地上的水，水變成水氣飛到天上。
水氣在高高的天空變冷，變成很多小水滴，聚在一起就是雲。
雲裡的水滴變大變重，就會落下來變成雨。
雨流到河和海裡，水又會再旅行一次。
answers_en: The sun warms water, and it rises into the sky. Cold air turns it into clouds.
Cloud drops get big and heavy, and fall as rain. Then the water travels again.
The water in the {object} goes up and comes down again.
answers_zh: 太陽曬熱水，水飛到天上變成雲。
雲裡的水滴變重，就落下來變成雨。

question_examples_en: why do clouds not fall down
what are clouds made of
why are clouds white
why are some clouds dark
how do clouds float
why do clouds move
how do clouds get made
why do clouds have different shapes
facts_en: A cloud is made of billions of tiny drops of water.
The drops are so small and light that moving air holds them up.
Clouds look white because the drops bounce light around.
Thick clouds look dark because less light gets through them.
facts_zh: 雲是由很多很多小水滴聚在一起的。
水滴又小又輕，會被流動的空氣托住。
雲看起來是白的，因為小水滴把光彈來彈去。
很厚的雲光線穿不過去，看起來是暗的。
answers_en: A cloud is made of tiny drops of water. They are so light that air holds them up.
The {object} is full of tiny water drops. Wind moves it along.
Tiny drops bounce light, so a cloud looks white. A thick cloud looks dark.
answers_zh: 雲是很多小水滴。它們很輕，空氣托得住。
{object}是小水滴聚成的，風會把它吹走。

question_examples_en: why does it snow
why is snow white
why is snow cold
why is there snow on top of mountains
how are snowflakes made
why does it snow in winter but rain in summer
why do icicles hang down
what is frost
facts_en: Snow is frozen water. It forms when clouds are cold enough to freeze the tiny drops.
Snowflakes are tiny ice crystals that stick together.
Snow looks white because the ice bounces all the light back.
The air is colder high up, so mountain tops often have snow.
facts_zh: 雪是結冰的水。雲冷到夠冷，小水滴就會結成冰。
雪花是很多小冰晶黏在一起。
雪看起來是白的，因為冰把所有的光都彈回來。
越高的地方空氣越冷，所以山頂常常有雪。
answers_en: The {object} is frozen water. Water freezes when the air is cold enough.
Snow forms when clouds are cold. Tiny drops freeze and stick together.
Snow looks white because tiny ice bits bounce the light back.
answers_zh: {object}是結冰的水。空氣夠冷，水就會結冰。
雲很冷的時候，小水滴結成冰，就變成雪。

question_examples_en: why does water flow
why is a rock hard
why can I not see air
what is a solid
why does juice take the shape of the cup
what is a gas
why is water wet
why can I pour milk but not a rock
facts_en: A solid keeps its own shape, like a rock or a block.
A liquid flows and takes the shape of its cup, like water or juice.
A gas, like air, is usually invisible and spreads everywhere.
The same thing can be a solid, liquid or gas depending on how hot it is.
facts_zh: 固體有自己的形狀，像石頭和積木。
液體會流動，會變成杯子的形狀，像水和果汁。
氣體像空氣，看不見，會跑到每個地方。
同一種東西，冷熱不一樣，可能變成固體、液體或氣體。
answers_en: Things are solids, liquids or gases. The {object} is one of those.
A solid keeps its shape. A liquid flows and a gas spreads out.
Rocks are solids, water is a liquid and air is a gas.
answers_zh: 東西有固體、液體和氣體。{object}是其中一種。
固體有形狀，液體會流，氣體會散開。

question_examples_en: what is air
why can I not see air
why does a balloon get big when I blow in it

question_examples_zh: 為什麼冬天白天比較短
facts_en: The Earth goes around the sun once in a year.
The Earth is tilted, so through the year a place sometimes leans toward the sun and sometimes away.
Leaning toward the sun means longer days and warm weather, which is summer. Leaning away means shorter days and cold weather, which is winter.
Spring and autumn are in between.
facts_zh: 地球繞著太陽走一大圈，要走一年。
地球是斜斜的，所以一年裡，不同的地方有時比較對著太陽，有時比較偏。
比較對著太陽時，白天長、天氣熱，是夏天；偏開時，白天短、天氣冷，是冬天。
春天和秋天是在中間。
answers_en: The Earth is tilted as it goes around the sun. That gives us seasons.
In summer, our place leans toward the sun. In winter, it leans away.
The Earth is tilted, so we get the {object}.
answers_zh: 地球斜斜地繞著太陽走，所以有四季。

The side facing the sun has day, and the side facing away has night.

地球的另一邊，白天的時候我們這裡是晚上。

answers_zh: 地球一天轉一圈。對著太陽的一面是白天。

answers_en: The sun is low in the morning, so shadows are long.

answers_zh: 早上和傍晚太陽低，影子就長。
中午太陽高，影子就短。

A big thing like a planet gets pulled into a round ball.
Small things, like tiny space rocks, are too small to be pulled round and can be lumpy.
facts_zh: 重力會把大東西的每一部分都往中間拉。
像行星這麼大的東西，就被拉成圓圓的球。
很小的東西，像小小的太空石頭，拉不圓，所以可能是凹凸不平的。
answers_en: Every part of the {object} is pulled toward its middle. That makes a round ball.
A very big thing pulls itself into a round ball.
Very big things end up round, like the Earth.
answers_zh: {object}的每一部分都被往中間拉，就變成圓球。
很大的東西會被自己的力拉成球。

why do flowers have petals
facts_en: Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.
The stem carries water up to the leaves and holds the plant up.
Leaves make food.
Flowers make fruits and seeds. Many are bright and sweet-smelling to attract bees and butterflies.
facts_zh: 根把植物固定在土裡，也吸水。

葉子做養分。

facts_en: Many plants grow from seeds.
A seed sprouts when it has water, warmth and air.
The sprout grows into a seedling and then a big plant, which makes new seeds.
Fruits usually have seeds inside, and the seeds can grow into new plants.
facts_zh: 很多植物是從種子長出來的。
種子有水、暖暖的、有空氣，就會發芽。
芽長大變成幼苗，再變成大植物，大植物又會有新的種子。
水果裡面通常有種子，種子可以長成新的植物。
answers_en: A seed has a tiny new plant inside. With water and warmth, it sprouts.
The {object} can grow if it has water and warmth.
A sprout grows into a plant. The plant then makes new seeds.
answers_zh: 種子裡有一棵小小的新植物。有水和暖暖的就會發芽。
{object}有水、暖暖的、有空氣，就能長大。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼秋天葉子會變紅變黃

facts_en: In fall, many trees stop making the green stuff in their leaves.
Then the yellow and orange colors that were hidden show up.
Many trees drop their leaves for the cold winter and grow new ones in spring.
facts_zh: 秋天到了，很多樹不再做葉子裡的綠色東西。
原本藏著的黃色和橘色就露出來了。
很多樹在寒冷的冬天掉光葉子，春天再長新的。
answers_en: In fall, many trees stop making green. Other colors, like yellow and orange, show.

The {object} changes as the tree gets ready for winter.
answers_zh: 秋天很多樹不再做綠色。黃色和橘色等別的顏色就露出來了。
很多樹冬天掉葉子，春天再長新葉子。

question_examples_en: why do bees make honey
why do bees go to flowers
how do bees make honey
why do bees buzz
why do flowers need bees
what do bees do all day
why do bees live in a hive
why do butterflies land on flowers
facts_en: Bees drink a sweet juice called nectar from flowers.
They carry the nectar home and turn it into honey to eat.
Flower dust (pollen) sticks to bees and gets carried to other flowers.
That helps flowers make seeds and fruits.
facts_zh: 蜜蜂會從花裡喝甜甜的花蜜。
牠們把花蜜帶回家，做成蜂蜜來吃。
花粉會沾在蜜蜂身上，被帶到別的花。

answers_en: Bees drink sweet nectar from flowers. They turn it into honey to eat.
Bees and flowers help each other. The bee gets food, and the flower gets help making seeds.
The {object} is part of how bees and flowers work together.
answers_zh: 蜜蜂從花裡喝花蜜，把它做成蜂蜜來吃。
蜜蜂得到食物，花得到幫忙結種子。

principles.name_zh: 動物的身體適合牠的生活
question_examples_en: why do giraffes have long necks
why do polar bears have white fur
why do camels have humps
why do birds have wings
why do fish have fins
why do penguins not get cold
why do elephants have long trunks
why do ducks have webbed feet
question_examples_zh: 長頸鹿的脖子為什麼那麼長
北極熊為什麼是白色的
facts_en: An animal's body is shaped in a way that helps it live.
A long neck can reach tall leaves, thick fur or fat keeps an animal warm, and wings let it fly.
Animals in different places have different bodies, like camels in the desert and bears in the Arctic.
facts_zh: 動物身體的樣子，剛好幫助牠們活下去。
長脖子可以吃到高高的樹葉，厚厚的毛或脂肪可以保暖，翅膀可以飛。
不同地方的動物，身體也不一樣，像沙漠的駱駝和北極的熊。
answers_en: The {object} helps the animal live where it lives.
Animal bodies are shaped to help them live.
Over a very long time, animals with helpful bodies lived on.
answers_zh: {object}幫動物在牠住的地方活下去。
動物的身體剛好適合牠的生活。

principles.name_en: Animals in winter (sleeping and moving away)

question_examples_zh: 為什麼熊整個冬天都在睡覺
為什麼有些動物會冬眠
facts_en: In winter it is cold and food is hard to find.
Some animals, like bears and bats, sleep a lot in winter and use less food.
Some animals, like many birds, fly or swim to a warmer place.
Some animals, like squirrels, store food before winter.
facts_zh: 冬天很冷，食物很難找。
有些動物，像熊和蝙蝠，冬天睡很久，這樣吃得比較少。
有些動物，像很多鳥，會飛或游到比較暖的地方。
有些動物，像松鼠，冬天以前會先藏好食物。
answers_en: In winter, food is hard to find. So some animals sleep, and some go somewhere warm.
Some animals sleep through winter and some travel to warmer places.
Some animals save food before winter comes.
answers_zh: 冬天食物很少。有的動物睡覺，有的飛到暖的地方。
有的動物冬天以前，會先把食物藏起來。

question_examples_en: why do birds build nests

facts_en: Animals need food, water, air and a safe place to live.
The place an animal lives is its habitat, like a forest, ocean or desert.
Many animals make homes, like nests and burrows, to stay safe and raise babies.
facts_zh: 動物需要食物、水、空氣和安全的地方住。
動物住的地方叫棲地，像森林、海洋、沙漠。

answers_zh: 動物需要安全的地方住。{object}讓牠們安全。
很多動物做家，保護自己和寶寶。

question_examples_zh: 小雞是怎麼從蛋裡出來的

facts_en: Animals have babies, the babies grow up, and then they have babies of their own.
Some animals hatch from eggs, like chickens and frogs. Others are born alive, like cats and dogs.
A caterpillar becomes a chrysalis, then a butterfly.
Animal parents often look after their babies.
facts_zh: 動物會生寶寶，寶寶會長大，長大後又會生新的寶寶。
有的動物從蛋裡出來，像雞和青蛙；有的動物直接生寶寶，像貓和狗。
毛毛蟲會變成蛹，再變成蝴蝶。
動物媽媽或爸爸常常會照顧寶寶。
answers_en: The {object} will grow up. Grown-up animals have babies of their own.
Some baby animals come out of eggs. Others are born alive.
A caterpillar becomes a butterfly. A tadpole becomes a frog.
answers_zh: {object}會長大，長大後也會生寶寶。
有的寶寶從蛋裡出來，有的直接出生。

principles.name_en: Why animals eat what they eat

When one eats another, we get a food chain.

facts_en: Living things grow, and need water, food or nutrients, and air.

facts_en: Animals cannot talk like us, so they use sounds and body moves to tell others things.
A dog often wags its tail when it is excited or friendly.
A cat often purrs when it is calm.
facts_zh: 動物不能像人一樣說話，所以用聲音和身體動作告訴別人事情。

facts_en: Bodies make heat, and they must not get too hot.
People sweat, and dogs pant. Water on the skin or tongue dries and takes heat away.
A fan helps sweat dry faster, so you feel cooler.
Some animals cool off in water or mud.
facts_zh: 身體會產生熱，不可以太熱。
人會流汗，狗會喘氣。皮膚或舌頭上的水變乾時，會帶走熱。

Sweat and panting both cool the body as the water dries off.
answers_zh: 身體熱時，皮膚上的水變乾，會帶走熱。
{object}幫身體涼下來。

question_examples_zh: 為什麼眼睛閉起來就看不到
facts_en: We see with our eyes, hear with our ears, smell with our nose, taste with our tongue and feel with our skin.
Our eyes catch light and our ears catch sound, and they send messages to the brain.
The brain tells us what it is, and lets us feel cold, hot and pain.
Nose and tongue work together so we can taste food.

We sense the world with eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin.

answers_zh: {object}把訊息送給腦袋。
眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、舌頭和皮膚幫我們感覺。

facts_en: We breathe in air, which has the good air our body needs.

When we rest, breathing and heartbeat slow down.

跑步或玩得很用力時，身體需要更多空氣，所以我們會喘、心跳也會變快。
休息的時候，呼吸和心跳會慢下來。
answers_en: When you run, your {object} works harder.
The heart is a pump that sends blood around your body. It beats faster when you play hard.
We breathe in air because the body needs it. We breathe harder when we run.
answers_zh: 跑步時，{object}會動得更快。
心臟像幫浦，把血送到全身。

principles.name_en: Why we eat (food and the body)

why do we need to eat food
where does food go when I eat it
why do I feel hungry
why do I poop
why do I need to chew my food
why does my tummy hurt if I eat too much
why do we eat three meals
question_examples_zh: 吃下去的東西去哪裡了
facts_en: Food gives the body strength and helps us grow.
Food is chewed in the mouth and goes to the tummy, and the body takes what it needs.
What is left over leaves the body as poop and pee.
When the tummy is empty, the body tells us we are hungry.
facts_zh: 食物給身體力氣，也讓我們長大。
食物在嘴巴被嚼碎，再到肚子裡，身體拿走需要的部分。
沒用的部分變成大便和小便，離開身體。
肚子空空的時候，身體會告訴我們：我餓了。
answers_en: Your body uses the {object} for strength and to grow.
Food gives your body strength. What it cannot use leaves as poop and pee.
When your tummy is empty, your body says it is hungry. Then you eat.
answers_zh: 你的身體會用{object}來變有力氣和長大。
食物給身體力氣。用不到的會變成大便和小便。

question_examples_en: why do I have to wash my hands
what are germs
why do I get sick
why do I need to cover my sneeze
why do I wear a mask
how do colds spread

answers_en: Tiny germs we cannot see can make us sick. Soap and water wash them off.
Germs can be on the {object}. So we wash our hands.
Cover coughs and sneezes so germs do not reach other people.
answers_zh: 有很小很小的壞蟲蟲，會讓我們生病。用肥皂洗掉它們。
{object}上可能有壞蟲蟲，所以要洗手。

question_examples_en: why do I have to brush my teeth
why do I get cavities
why do my teeth fall out
why do sweets make holes in teeth
why do I need to go to the dentist
why do I have baby teeth
why do teeth get loose
why do new teeth grow in

Germs in the mouth use sugar to make an acid that makes holes in teeth. We call these cavities.
Brushing every day cleans away the food bits and germs.
Baby teeth fall out and new big teeth grow in, but big teeth do not grow back.
facts_zh: 牙齒幫我們咬和嚼食物。
嘴巴裡的壞蟲蟲愛吃糖，會做出酸酸的東西把牙齒弄出洞，就是蛀牙。
每天刷牙，可以把食物渣和壞蟲蟲刷掉。
乳牙會掉，新的大牙會長出來，大牙掉了不會再長。
answers_en: Brushing cleans food and germs off your {object}.
Germs in your mouth use sugar to make acid. The acid can make holes in teeth.
Baby teeth fall out so big teeth can grow in. Big teeth do not grow back.
answers_zh: 刷牙把{object}上的髒東西刷掉。
乳牙會掉，新牙會長出來，大牙掉了不會再長。

question_examples_en: why do I get a scab

why do bruises turn blue
why do cuts itch when they heal

why do I get a blister

Do not pick at a scab, so the cut heals faster.
facts_zh: 皮膚受傷流血，血會慢慢變乾變硬，蓋住傷口，這是痂。
痂像小小的繃帶，保護下面長出新的皮膚。

不要一直摳痂，傷口才會好得比較快。

痂像小繃帶，下面長好新皮，它就會掉。

question_examples_en: why do I have to sleep

why do I need to exercise
why do I feel sleepy
why do I need a nap
why is sleep good for me

facts_en: The body gets tired from using strength, and sleep lets it rest and grow.
With enough sleep, we have more energy and focus better the next day.
Exercise makes muscles and the heart stronger.
Scientists are still learning everything that sleep does.
facts_zh: 身體用了力氣會累，睡覺的時候身體可以休息和長大。
睡得夠，白天比較有精神，也比較能專心。
運動讓肌肉和心臟變強壯。
科學家還在研究睡覺對身體所有的幫助。
answers_en: Your body and brain rest and grow when you sleep.
The {object} is good for your body and brain.
Sleep helps you have more strength the next day. Exercise makes muscles and the heart strong.
answers_zh: 睡覺時，身體和腦袋可以休息和長大。
{object}對身體和腦袋都有好處。

principles.name_en: Tastes: sour, sweet, salty and bitter
question_examples_en: why do lemons taste sour
why is sugar sweet
why does salt taste salty
why does coffee taste bitter
why are some things sour
how does my tongue taste things
why does vinegar make my face scrunch up
why do I like sweet things
facts_en: Your tongue has tiny taste bumps that can taste sweet, sour, salty and bitter.
Lemons and vinegar taste sour because they have an acid in them.
Sugar tastes sweet, and salt tastes salty.
Smell helps taste, so food tastes plain when your nose is blocked.
facts_zh: 舌頭上有很多小小的味蕾，嘗得出甜、酸、鹹和苦。
檸檬和醋有酸酸的東西在裡面，所以嘗起來是酸的。
糖是甜的，鹽是鹹的。
鼻子會幫忙嘗味道，所以鼻塞的時候食物會沒味道。
answers_en: Your tongue tastes the {object} with tiny taste bumps.
Your tongue can taste sweet, sour, salty and bitter.
Sour things, like lemons and vinegar, have an acid in them.
answers_zh: 舌頭嘗得出{object}的味道。
舌頭嘗得出甜、酸、鹹和苦。

question_examples_en: why do my fingers get wrinkly in the bath
why do my toes get wrinkly in the pool
why does my skin get wrinkly in water
why do I get pruney fingers
why do my hands wrinkle when I swim
why does water make my fingers wrinkly
why are my fingertips wrinkly after a bath
why do only my fingers and toes wrinkle
question_examples_zh: 為什麼泡澡手指會皺皺的
為什麼游泳腳趾會皺起來
facts_en: After a long time in water, the skin on fingers and toes wrinkles.
The body does this by itself.
Scientists think the wrinkles may help us grip wet things.
facts_zh: 泡在水裡很久以後，手指和腳趾的皮膚會皺起來。
這是身體自己做的。
科學家覺得，皺紋可能幫我們抓牢濕濕的東西。
answers_en: In water, the skin on your {object} wrinkles by itself.
Your body wrinkles the skin on fingers and toes by itself. It may help you grip wet things.
The wrinkles go away when your skin dries.
answers_zh: 泡水久了，{object}會自己皺起來。
皮膚乾了以後，皺紋就會不見。

question_examples_en: why do I get dizzy when I spin
how do I keep my balance
why do I fall over when I spin around
why does the world look like it is spinning
why can I stand on one leg
why do I get dizzy on a merry-go-round
why do I feel funny after a spinning ride
how does my body know which way is up
question_examples_zh: 為什麼轉完圈會站不穩
身體怎麼知道哪邊是上面
facts_en: Inside our ears are tiny tubes with a little liquid.
The liquid moves when we move, and it tells the brain which way we are going.
When we spin and stop, the liquid keeps moving for a bit. The brain gets mixed-up messages and we feel dizzy.
Our eyes and feet help us balance too.
facts_zh: 我們的耳朵裡有小小的管子，裡面有一點水。
我們動的時候，水也會動，告訴腦袋我們往哪個方向。
轉圈圈停下來以後，水還會動一下，腦袋收到亂亂的訊息，我們就頭暈了。
眼睛和腳也會幫我們保持平衡。
answers_en: Your {object} helps you keep your balance.
Your ears have tiny tubes with a little liquid inside. After you stop spinning, it keeps moving, and you feel dizzy.
The liquid in your ears keeps moving after you stop. That mixes up your brain.
answers_zh: {object}幫你保持平衡。
轉完圈，耳朵裡的水還在動，所以頭暈。

principles.name_en: Thirst and water in the body
question_examples_en: why do I get thirsty
why do I need to drink water
why does my mouth feel dry
why do I get thirsty when I play
how much water is in my body
why do I pee so much
why do I feel thirsty after running
why can I not live without water
question_examples_zh: 為什麼運動完會很想喝水
facts_en: Much of our body is water.
We lose water all day when we sweat, pee and breathe out.
When the body needs more water, it makes us feel thirsty.
Drinking water fills the body back up.
facts_zh: 我們身體裡有很多水。
我們流汗、尿尿、呼氣，一整天都會失去水。
身體需要更多水的時候，就會讓我們覺得口渴。
喝水可以讓身體補回水。
answers_en: Your body needs water, and the {object} gives it some.
You lose water when you sweat and pee. Thirst tells you to drink more.
Much of your body is water. You must drink to keep it filled.
answers_zh: {object}可以補水給你的身體。
身體缺水，就會想喝水。

principles.name_en: Gas bubbles in bread and fizzy drinks
question_examples_en: why does bread get big when it bakes
why does soda fizz
why are there holes in bread
why does dough rise
how do bubbles get in soda
why does a cake get puffy
why does the soda burp when I open it
what makes bread soft and puffy
question_examples_zh: 為什麼麵包烤了會變大
facts_en: Bread dough has yeast, a tiny living thing that eats sugar and makes bubbles of gas.
The bubbles puff the dough up, and baking makes it firm with holes inside.
Fizzy drinks have gas pushed into them. It bubbles out when you open the bottle.
facts_zh: 麵團裡有酵母，是很小的生物，會吃糖，放出一個個氣泡。
氣泡把麵團撐大，烤過以後變硬，裡面就有洞洞。
汽水裡被壓進去很多氣，打開瓶子時就冒出來。
answers_en: Tiny bubbles of gas are inside the {object}. Those bubbles make it fizzy or fluffy.
Bread dough has yeast that makes gas bubbles. The bubbles make the dough big and fluffy.
Bread and fizzy drinks both have little bubbles of gas in them.
answers_zh: {object}裡面有很多小氣泡，把它撐大。
麵團裡的酵母會放出氣泡，麵包就變大變軟。

question_examples_en: why is sand so tiny
where does sand come from
why are pebbles smooth
how are mountains made smaller
why are river stones round
how do rocks turn into sand
why do beaches have sand
where does soil come from
question_examples_zh: 河邊的石頭為什麼圓圓的
facts_en: Rocks come in many sizes, and some are hard and some are soft.
Wind, water and ice slowly wear big rocks into small stones, sand and soil.
This takes a very, very long time.
Soil has tiny rock bits and bits of dead leaves, so plants can grow in it.
facts_zh: 岩石有大有小，有硬有軟。
風、水和冰會把大岩石慢慢磨碎，變成小石頭、沙和土。
這要很久很久的時間。
土裡有小小的石頭碎片和死掉的葉子，所以植物可以在裡面長大。
answers_en: In a long time, wind and water wear the {object} down.
Wind, water and ice slowly wear big rocks into sand.
Rocks rub together in rivers and waves. They become smooth and small.
answers_zh: 過很久很久，風和水會把{object}磨小。
風、水和冰慢慢把大岩石磨成沙。

question_examples_en: why is the ocean salty
why is seawater salty
why can I not drink sea water
where does salt in the sea come from
why is the sea water not like a river
where does sea salt come from
why does the sea taste salty
why are rivers not salty
facts_en: Most of the water on Earth is in the sea.
Water flowing over rocks and soil picks up a little salt and carries it to the sea.
When sea water dries up, the salt stays behind.
We cannot drink seawater. Rivers and lakes have fresh water, which needs to be clean to drink.
facts_zh: 地球上大部分的水在海裡。
水流過岩石和土時，會帶走一點鹽，一直流到海裡。
海水曬乾後，鹽會留下來。
海水不能直接喝；河水和湖水是淡水，要乾淨才能喝。
answers_en: Rivers carry a little salt from rocks to the sea. When sea water dries, the salt stays.
Rivers have carried salt to the {object} for a long time.
Sea water is too salty to drink. Rivers and lakes have fresh water.
answers_zh: 河水把岩石裡一點鹽帶進海裡，所以海水鹹。
海水太鹹，不能喝。

question_examples_en: why does the ground shake in an earthquake
what is an earthquake
why do earthquakes happen
why does the floor shake
what do I do in an earthquake
why do we get earthquakes
can the ground move
why do buildings shake
question_examples_zh: 為什麼地震的時候地面會搖
facts_en: The Earth's surface is made of huge pieces of rock that move very, very slowly.
When the rock pieces bump or slide, the ground shakes. That is an earthquake.
In an earthquake, get under a sturdy table and protect your head.
facts_zh: 地球的表面是一大片一大片的岩石，很慢很慢地在動。
岩石碰在一起或滑動時，地面會搖，這就是地震。
地震時要躲在桌子下，保護頭部。
answers_en: The {object} happens when rock under the ground moves.
Huge pieces of rock move very slowly. When they slip, the ground shakes.
In an earthquake, get under a table and cover your head.
answers_zh: 地底的大岩石動了，地面就會搖。
地震時要躲到桌子下面，保護頭。

question_examples_en: why do volcanoes explode
what is lava
why is lava hot
what is inside a volcano
how are volcanoes made
why does a volcano erupt
where does lava come from
why do volcanoes spit fire
facts_en: Deep inside the Earth it is very hot, and some rock melts.
Hot melted rock pushes up and comes out of a volcano. We call it lava when it is outside.
Lava cools and turns back into hard rock.
facts_zh: 地球裡面很深的地方很熱，有些岩石會熔化。
滾燙的熔岩會往上擠，從火山跑出來。
熔岩冷了以後，會變回硬硬的岩石。
answers_en: Deep inside the Earth, rock is so hot that it melts. The {object} is where it comes out.
Hot melted rock pushes up and comes out of a volcano. Outside, it is called lava.
Lava cools and turns back into hard rock.
answers_zh: 地球深處很熱，岩石會熔化，從火山跑出來。
熔岩冷了，就變回硬石頭。

question_examples_en: why does a candle go out when I blow
why does fire need air
why is fire hot
why does fire go out
how does fire burn
why is fire red and orange
how do you put out a fire
why do we blow out candles
question_examples_zh: 為什麼吹一吹蠟燭就熄了
facts_en: A fire needs something to burn, air and heat.
Without air a fire goes out, like a candle under a glass.
Grown-ups put out fires; some fires must not get water.
Fire is hot and dangerous, so children must not play with it.
facts_zh: 火要有東西燒、空氣和熱，才會燒起來。
沒有空氣，火就會熄掉，像蠟燭蓋上杯子。
水可以讓火熄掉。
火很燙很危險，小朋友不可以玩火。
answers_en: A fire needs something to burn, air and heat. The {object} needs air to keep burning.
Without air, a fire goes out. A glass over a candle makes the flame stop.
Fire is hot and dangerous. Children must never play with it.
answers_zh: 火要有東西燒、空氣和熱。{object}也要空氣才會燒。
沒有空氣，火就會熄掉。

question_examples_en: why does milk go bad
why do we put food in the fridge
why does bread get moldy
why does fruit go rotten
why can I not eat old food
why is the fridge cold
why do leftovers go in the fridge
why does food get smelly
question_examples_zh: 為什麼放久的東西不能吃
facts_en: Food left for a long time grows germs and mold, and goes bad.
Germs grow faster when it is warm.
A fridge is cold, so germs grow slowly and food lasts longer.
Bad food can give us a tummy ache, so we must not eat it.
facts_zh: 食物放久了，壞蟲蟲和黴會長在上面，食物就會壞掉。
天氣熱的時候，壞蟲蟲長得比較快。
冰箱很冷，壞蟲蟲長得很慢，食物可以放比較久。
壞掉的食物會讓人肚子痛，不可以吃。
answers_en: Germs and mold grow on the {object} if it sits out.
A fridge is cold, so germs grow slowly. Food lasts longer there.
Old food can give you a tummy ache. So we do not eat it.
answers_zh: {object}放太久，會長壞蟲蟲或黴。
冰箱很冷，壞蟲蟲長得慢，食物可以放久一點。

question_examples_en: how do phones let me talk to grandma
how does a phone work
how can I hear someone far away
how does my voice go through the phone
how does a video call work
how does a phone call get to the other phone
how can grandma see me on the phone
how does a walkie-talkie work
question_examples_zh: 電話為什麼可以跟奶奶說話
為什麼可以聽到很遠的人說話
視訊電話是怎麼做到的
facts_en: A phone has a tiny microphone that turns your voice into a signal.
The signal travels far, through wires or through the air as invisible waves.
The other phone turns the signal back into sound, so your friend hears you.
facts_zh: 手機裡有小小的麥克風，把你的聲音變成訊號。
訊號會跑得很遠，走電線，或在空氣裡變成看不見的波。
另一支電話把訊號變回聲音，朋友就聽到你了。
answers_en: A phone sends your talk far away as a message.
The other phone turns the message back into sound. Then your friend hears you.
The {object} sends your talk far away.
answers_zh: 電話把你的聲音變成訊號，送到很遠的地方。
另一支電話把訊號變回聲音，朋友就聽到了。
